name: Registration form validation test
goal: Run a negative test suite against the registration form. For each test case, start from a fresh form (reload the page, or use 'Register another account' if a registration went through), fill the form with valid baseline data except for the field under test, submit, and verify the form rejects the input with a visible, field-specific error. If a case is accepted, record it as a defect.
description: Baseline valid data: full name 'Test User', email 'test.user@acme-demo.test', plan Starter, seats 1, terms accepted.
successCriteria: Submitting without accepting the terms is rejected
